name: Syncretism Mahou Kitan Shoujo Hupunerotomakia
original_name: シンクレティズム魔法奇譚 少女ヒュプネロトマキア
source:
Shortly after birth my child is about to meet death.
The elder witch uses a spell and tethers the child to life.

My daughter grows up safely, another spell seal is no longer necessary.
However no matter how much I try, I can never successfully dispel the curse.

The girl approaches puberty, an unstable time.

Will there come a day when the curse can be broken?

(Translated from the official site)
translation:
孩子出生不久便濒临死亡。
年长的女巫施展法术，将孩子维系在生死线上。

女儿平安长大后，本以为不再需要封印法术。
然而无论我怎样努力，都无法成功解除诅咒。

女孩逐渐接近青春期，这是一个不稳定的时期。

诅咒终有一天能够被打破吗？

[译自官方网站]
